status: AI-authored demonstration; not human-reviewed; not a normative financial policy
goal: Determine whether the missing-acceptance-evidence exception on a positive goods invoice line can be proposed for closure under synthetic policy P0.
assumptions: Synthetic P0 policy is a test specification, not actual company policy or legal advice.
Quantities of distinct evidence records refer to nonoverlapping lots; overlap cannot be resolved in this pilot.
A directly supplied authorization flag is trusted for the test; real signer authorization must be separately verified.
Only positive-quantity goods invoices and exact unit identifiers are supported.
Closing the acceptance-evidence exception neither approves payment nor verifies prices, tax, fraud, contract compliance or all other controls.
Missing evidence does not establish that acceptance failed in the world.
